question: If supremacy is granted merely from being a means, does that wrongly extend to lamps and similar aids?
premises: Supremacy is proposed on the basis of being a means.
A lamp and similar things are also means.
The same basis would apply to them as well.
inference: If being a means confers supremacy, then lamps and the like would also have to be called supreme.
plain_english: If supremacy comes merely from being its means, then a lamp and so on would also have that status as means.
